title: SkuRecord
description: A SKU — one product the factory manufactures. This is the ORGANIZING SPINE: repos, assets, campaigns, and experiments reference a SKU by `sku_id`. `sku_id` is the unique key; `repo`, when set, must exist in repos.jsonl. One factory, many SKUs (DECISIONS.md D4).

sku_id.description: stable id, e.g. sku_001 — the spine key every other domain references

thesis.description: the one-line hypothesis this SKU is testing

repo.description: the SKU's product repo (owner/name) — must exist in repos.jsonl

launch_target.description: the bar that decides it, e.g. 'Day 29 first Stripe dollar'

drive_folder.description: per-SKU Google Drive folder URL, if mirrored
